build_rpn_with_ignore: build a Region Proposal Network that supports ignore thresholds for ground truth boxes with class < 0
create_label_and_sample_anchors: create anchor labels by matching anchors against ground truth boxes using pairwise IoU and IoA
test_dense_box_regression_loss_with_unce: test the dense box regression loss function that incorporates centerness-based uncertainty weighting
refactor_subsample_labels: refactor the label subsampling logic to use IoU-weighted multinomial sampling for positive and negative anchors
review_matched_pairwise_iou: review the matched pairwise IoU computation for two equally-sized box sets returning diagonal IoU values
